categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Pump Science Ecosystem
categories.content: Pump Science Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pump.science.

categories.name: STX.CITY Ecosystem
categories.content: STX.CITY Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via STX.CITY.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Kumbaya Launchpad
categories.content: Kumbaya is a community-first DEX and launchpad designed as a high-performance hub for 'cult' tokens and cultural assets.

categories.name: Tokenized Closed-End Funds (CEFs)
categories.content: Tokens representing shares of closed-end funds (CEFs), a typed of pooled investment vehicle that raises capital once and issue a fixed number of shares, with no ongoing creation or redemption mechanism. Tokenized CEFs are issued by a tokenization platform that holds the listed fund shares in custody and mints tokens against them, so the token inherits the fund's market price rather than its NAV.

categories.name: Avalanche L1
categories.content: Avalanche L1 are specialized sets of validators on Avalanche that allow the creation of customized independent networks with specific rules and governance to enable scalable and tailored blockchain solutions for various applications.

categories.name: Tradable Ecosystem
categories.content: Tradable Ecosystem consists of assets tokenised by https://www.tradable.xyz/.

categories.name: Wormhole Assets
categories.content: The Wormhole project is a bidirectional, decentralized SPL token bridge between Solana and EVM chains.

categories.name: Echo Launchpad
categories.content: Echo.xyz is a decentralized launchpad that enables early-stage project funding.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: Gaming Marketplace
categories.content: A platform where players can buy, sell, or trade in-game assets, currencies, or digital items.

categories.name: Tokenized Credit
categories.content: Tokens representing on-chain claims on debt instruments. Returns come from interest income and credit performance of the underlying borrowers, key risk dimensions are credit/default risk, seniority in the structure, and duration for fixed-rate instruments.

categories.name: Entertainment
categories.content: Projects that are specifically designed to be used within the entertainment sector, which may include areas such as music, film, gaming, and other forms of digital media.

categories.name: Binance Megadrop
categories.content: Binance Megadrop is an airdrop program by Binance. It allows users to earn rewards by subscribing to BNB to Locked Products and completing tasks within their Binance Web3 Wallet.

categories.name: Capital Launchpad (Kaito)
categories.content: Capital Launchpad is a Web3 crowdfunding platform by Kaito that connects early-stage crypto projects with investors through a merit-based allocation system.

categories.name: DN-404
categories.content: The "Divisible NFT" standard (DN-404) aims to be a hybrid of ERC20 and ERC721 that could act as an NFT with native fractionalization built in.
